headline: The INVADERS march learns to tick
lede: Slot b shipped the cabinet's 2px step granularity to SPACE INVADERS after correctly yielding the warden's TARGET to its live owner — the wall now moves the way 1978 moved it: whole steps, flush walls, sound on the ticks.

notes.text: The alien wall releases whole 2px machine steps instead of a continuous slide — carry-accumulated, so the pinned crawl→sprint speed law stays exact (drift under one pixel per 600 ticks), while every visible displacement is an integer tick. A near-death fleet now sprints past one step per frame.

The column stops square on the wall — never a pixel past, even at speed — then drops and reverses on the same step event: the cabinet's signature jerk. The descending four notes fire on those step ticks: sound and march finally share one clock.

TARGET #3565 (PONG RANGE) was refused at claim — slot a held it live, so this lane yielded and ran the honest ladder to a never-dry pick instead. Slot a shipped PONG; both slots shipped, no double-work.

Nine new granularity gates and four new mutants pin the step law (off-grid width, dropped carry, deleted clamp, metronome return all die). Two WITNESS timing floors were re-anchored with measured truth — whole-step release delays target arrival by less than one step; deletion mutants still die far outside the floors.

look.text: PONG — slot a's RANGE switch: pick the target score on the attract dial
